subject: history
concept: Understanding that ordinary people's daily lives were significantly affected during major world conflicts
source_inspiration: original content, presented factually and age-appropriately per the Education Conduct Policy — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student examines age-appropriate examples of home-front life (rationing, factory work, letters home)
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a home-front experience to the person who might have lived it
exercise.abstract: Student describes one way daily life changed for ordinary people during this era

misconception_flags: assumes only soldiers were affected by these conflicts, missing home-front impact

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
